statusLine.command: printf '%s · %s changes' "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)" "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r path; case "$path" in *firestore.rules) old=$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" show HEAD:firestore.rules 2>/dev/null | head -1); new=$(head -1 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/firestore.rules" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$new" ] && [ "$old" = "$new" ] && echo "⚠ firestore.rules edited but version line unchanged — bump // vX.Y.Z — YYYY-MM-DD on line 1" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r path; case "$path" in */docs/AI_INDEX.md) ;; */docs/*.md|*/docs/*/*.md|*/docs/*/*/*.md) echo "ℹ docs/ edited — run: python3 scripts/docs_tool.py all" >&2 ;; esac; exit 0; }

c=$(jq -r "(.tool_input.command // empty)"); seg=$(printf "%s\n" "$c" | sed -E "s/(&&|\|\||;|\|)/\n/g" | sed -E "s/^[[:space:]]+//" | grep -E "^git([[:space:]]+-c[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]|$)"); [ -n "$seg" ] || exit 0; printf "%s" "$seg" | grep -Eq -- "(--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes|--no-verify|(^|[[:space:]])-[A-Za-z]*f([[:space:]]|$)|[[:space:]][+][A-Za-z0-9_./^~-]+:)" || exit 0; printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Force push is forbidden in this repo under any circumstances. Never force push (--force, -f, --force-with-lease, --force-if-includes, +refspec) and never bypass hooks with --no-verify. If history really must be rewritten, ask the user to do it manually.\"}}"; exit 0
